title.narrative: Programa de reforma de los servicios de agua y saneamiento en el Distrito Central II
Water and sanitation services reform program in Central District II

description.narrative: El objetivo general de la serie programtica y de esta segunda operacin es mejorar la calidad e incrementar el acceso a los servicios de Agua y Saneamiento (AyS) en el Distrito Central (DC) a travs de un proceso de reformas que permitan consolidar la municipalizacin de los servicios de AyS mejorando la gobernanza sectorial y su gestin, en un contexto de Cambio Climtico (CC) y conducente a la seguridad hdrica. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) promover el desarrollo operativo y de gestin que permita incrementar la eficiencia en la prestacin de AyS de la Unidad Municipal de Agua Potable y Saneamiento (APyS) (UMAPS); (ii) contribuir a mejorar la sostenibilidad financiera de los servicios prestados por la UMAPS; (iii) fortalecer la planificacin de la UMAPS; y (iv) fortalecer el marco sectorial a travs de una mejor rectora, regulacin, gestin del recurso en un contexto de CC, y prestacin para atender mejor la demanda por los servicios. La presente operacin de prstamo es la segunda de dos operaciones, vinculadas tcnicamente entre s, financiadas en forma independiente bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico de Apoyo a Reformas de Poltica.

The general objective of the programmatic series and of this second operation is to improve the quality and increase access to Water and Sanitation (WASH) services in the Central District (DC) through a process of reforms that make it possible to consolidate the municipalization of WS services by improving sectoral governance and its management, in a context of Climate Change (CC) and conducive to water security. The specific objectives are: (i) to promote the operational and management development that allows increasing the efficiency in the provision of Water and Sanitation of the Municipal Unit of Drinking Water and Sanitation (APyS) (UMAPS); (ii) contribute to improving the financial sustainability of the services provided by the UMAPS; (iii) strengthen UMAPS planning; and (iv) strengthen the sectoral framework through better stewardship, regulation, resource management in a CC context, and provision to better meet the demand for services. This loan operation is the second of two operations, technically linked to each other, financed independently under the Programmatic Loan to Support Policy Reforms modality.
Commitment in 2023-09-20
Disbursement in second quarter of 2024
